meta.title: 🔧 refactor(github): Optimize GitHub config validation to run at app boot time
meta.body_summary: Refactor GitHub config validation to run at app boot time instead of on every API call, moving env var checks to instrumentation.ts and caching result.

perf_labels.notes: Devin moved env validation to instrumentation.ts; closed by maintainer within 9 minutes with no explicit feedback; only bot comments about migration and changesets.

change_scale_vs_repository.interpretation: At 31 changed lines, this is a tiny refactor by absolute volume, fitting a micro-performance optimization. It was closed without merge, possibly due to project conventions or lack of interest.

review_details.performance_claim: Move env validation from per-request to boot time to reduce redundant checks.

core_change_summary.description: Added env var validation in instrumentation.ts register() to run once at Next.js boot time; exposed a cached validation result in github/config.ts so that the webhook route.ts uses the cached result instead of re-validating on each call.
core_change_summary.secondary_note: Route changes are minimal (7 additions, 2 deletions) wiring to the cached config.
change_trajectory: Single commit adds validation to instrumentation.ts, exposes validateGitHubConfig() in config.ts, and updates route.ts to use it.
